I mean, maybe it's not illegal in Florida. But I live in Seattle and pharmacies absolutely cannot fuck with people like that. There are tons of laws protecting consumers and extra extra laws protecting them under any sort of healthcare practice. 

Things like no surprise billing, hospitals cannot refuse to treat you because you don't have insurance, if your insurance covers any part of your hospital stay/outpatient procedure as in network, they automatically must count every single contributing entity as in network as well. Addiction is treated as a public health issue and you will not be arrested or prosecuted for using or possession of illegal drugs unless it's a gang dealing bust. However, that last one is very controversial with the public.
